metadata.title: SEGUE-2 Limits on Metal-Rich Old-Population Hypervelocity Stars In the Galactic Halo

notes: No eligible stars are identified. T:p6-b3 reports 361 SEGUE-2 targets and states that none is moving in excess of, or even close to, Galactic escape speed, so no Galactic-unbound candidate is retained; T:p8-b2 likewise reports "no metal-rich hypervelocity stars." The Brown et al. (2009) HVS sample mentioned at T:p8-b5 is discussed only in aggregate (14 objects), with no individual star identifiers supplied.
